investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Coralpath Games (online gaming); Platform: Google Cloud asia-south1 (zones asia-south1-a/asia-south1-b/asia-south1-c); network range 10.119.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster coralp-prod-asiaso (GKE); matchmaking-svc pods run with 8 GiB memory limits; deployments are canary releases with automated analysis; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
